rules.date: Date the model or system was first public: model release date for tracker runs, paper or results date otherwise.
rules.ceiling: Human baseline where the benchmark publishes one, otherwise 100%.
rules.threshold: Threshold = base + f x (ceiling - base), base 0 (or the chance score when "above chance" is on), f = 80% or 90%.
rules.crossing: First point in any listed series of the benchmark at or above the threshold; 0 days if a model public at launch already scored that. Upper bounds never count.
rules.open: Not yet reached: elapsed time to 4 Oct 2026, or to the date a revision or successor replaced it.
